lede: Wat Phra That Lampang Luang accounts for 164 catalogued manuscripts, 32 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Lampang (97% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Ko Kha District. Nearly all (96%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (82%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (18%). Dated witnesses run 1697–1926 CE (107 of 164 carry a date).
